programs.title: Life Is Messy
programs.desc: Heather and Ian are hanging on by a thread: with two kids under three who don't sleep, and the end of maternity leave around the corner, they are exhausted and living in a constant state of anxiety and frustration; they're so overrun with clutter that their deep soaker tub has become storage; Kortney and Kenny rescue the pair by creating child-safe storage solutions, a custom kitchen pantry to get organized, and a revamped basement with a tub used for baths, not storage.

programs.title: Life Is Messy
programs.desc: After moving into their three-bedroom forever home, Catherine and Rob found out they were pregnant again and immediately felt the squeeze; managing three kids, two large dogs, and nightly musical beds, exhaustion has taken over and their home has descended into total chaos; Kortney and Kenny devise solutions with the grown-ups and the kids to bring back the beauty and the calm, so their house can stay their forever home.

programs.title: Life Is Messy
programs.desc: Ranjit bought her little home when she was a bachelorette; fast-forward 20 years later, and the walls are closing in on her family of three. Ranjit and husband Nabeel are in desperate need of a reset, but they don't know how to start. Kortney and Kenny guide them through a massive declutter, turning a man cave into a teenage-friendly space, making room for living, and calming the chaos.

programs.title: The Block Australia
programs.desc: Teams compete to see who can renovate houses on Phillip Island for the most profit, as the properties are placed on auction soon after refurbishments are completed.

programs.title: Sun, Sea and Selling Houses
programs.desc: Two British families set up shop in Spain to sell property to Britain families looking for a bit of fun in the sun.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: Hunting for a House and a Husband in Hanoi
programs.desc: A woman has international teaching credentials in China looks to relocate to Hanoi, Vietnam; she's looking to gain more teaching experience and more of a personal life, but finding a place big enough to hold all her stuff may be a challenge.
